summary: Added src/repo-chat module with typed session/worker contracts, implemented repo-chat-store persistence at ~/.moltbot/repo-chats/<id>/session.json with built-in message-id lookup indexing (save/load/find-by-message-id), and implemented repo-chat-worker using runCliProcess for Claude Code and Codex in read-only mode (Claude: --allowedTools Read,Glob,Grep,Bash + read-only system prompt; Codex: --sandbox read-only). Resume calls explicitly re-apply restrictions on every invocation. Added unit tests for store indexing/persistence and worker args/parsing/resume behavior. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/repo-chat/ (pass) and pnpm build (pass).
